items.title: AI Inference Costs Plummet
items.summary: The cost of GPT-4 class inference has fallen by up to 900x in a year, making advanced AI capabilities dramatically more accessible.
items.so_what: This massive cost reduction fundamentally reshapes the economics of AI, enabling new applications and intensifying competition across all layers.

items.title: AI Inference Costs Plummet: Intelligence is Now Free

items.title: AI Inference Costs Plummet: 'Intelligence is Free'
items.summary: AI inference costs have fallen 9x-900x in a year, making advanced LLM capabilities nearly free.
items.so_what: This dramatic cost reduction fundamentally reshapes AI economics, enabling new applications and business models across the value chain.

items.title: LLMs Learn to Update Beliefs for Efficient Long-Horizon Interaction
items.summary: A new method (ABBEL) allows LLMs to manage long interactions efficiently by updating beliefs, bypassing context window limits.
items.so_what: This significantly improves LLM performance and cost-efficiency for complex, multi-turn tasks, enabling more capable AI agents.

items.title: Intelligence is Free: Data Systems for Agents
items.summary: LLM inference costs have plummeted up to 900x, shifting focus to data systems for and by AI agents.
items.so_what: This drastic cost reduction fundamentally alters AI economics, enabling new agentic applications and shifting value to data infrastructure.

items.title: CUDA to MLX: K-Search enables Apple Silicon AI
items.summary: K-Search translates CUDA optimization knowledge to MLX for Apple Silicon, enabling AI workloads on diverse hardware.
items.so_what: This initiative directly challenges NVIDIA's CUDA moat, potentially diversifying AI hardware adoption beyond GPUs.

items.title: LLMs Update Beliefs for Efficient Long-Horizon Interaction
items.summary: A new method, ABBEL, allows LLMs to update beliefs instead of full history, improving long-horizon interaction efficiency.
items.so_what: This enhances LLM agent capabilities, making complex, multi-step AI applications more practical and cost-effective.
